```{r knit-setup, include=FALSE}
# Knit either from vignettes/ or from the package root: child documents are
# named relative to this file, so the root directory is moved to vignettes/
# whenever the knit starts somewhere else (e.g. RStudio's "Project Directory").
if (!dir.exists("children") && dir.exists(file.path("vignettes", "children"))) {
 knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("vignettes"))
}
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(visStatistics)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
 fig.width = 7,
 fig.height = 4.5,
 out.width = "100%",
 echo = TRUE
)
example_alpha <- 0.05
options(visStatistics.qq_nsim = 999L)
```
